title: The Superman
subtitle: The light of reason shall one day shine upon the earth.

trails.title: Vertin's Suitcase
trails.description: You must leave the way you came. Familiarize yourself with the world after a thousand years, and understand how to master the flames.

items.text: inside the suitcase

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Desert Flannel's dizziness is in remission. She's already well enough to deal with her business on the fax machine. Will it do harm to her physical condition?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Ms. Desert Flannel is only experiencing a very mild reaction. She can move around freely, and it is recommended for her to do so. Ms. Spathodea, on the contrary ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: She's not even awake.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: No. But her body temperature and her arcanum level are getting stable now. She should wake up in any minute.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is it because she took part in too many events in the Stadium?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: That's right. She has to stay in bed for the next three days.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: As well as Ms. Regulus and Mr. APPLe. I have asked Ms. Bunny to send them the medicine. If everything went well, they should have woken up by now ...

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Dr. Ezra, I'm back!
The bunny girl pops out from between the crack in the door.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Both Mr. APPLe and Ms. Regulus are awake now, so I gave them some medicine! But ... Ms. Ulu is still in a coma ...

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Don't worry, Ms. Ulu is different to the other unconscious arcanists. She was weakened by the long sleep, while the other arcanists lost consciousness because of external factors.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Look, this is their physiological data in the last three hours.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Many arcanists have told us that their physical abilities were improved as they entered the Stadium. They felt they were in a refreshed state like they had a good sleep or rested properly.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: But after they competed in 4 to 6 different games, or the average sporting time exceeded 3.5 hours, they would feel dizzy, as if they had consumed too much alcohol.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And these symptoms were relieved soon after they left the Stadium.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Ah, you mean ... people are in oblivion because of that ... Stadium?

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: If that place is so dangerous, is it possible to hold the Games again?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: I think this is why in the past, athletes were only allowed to compete in three different sports. As long as we stick with the same rule, the safety of our athletes shouldn't be problematic.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Oh! I got it! So this place is just as safe as the club I work in! As long as we ain't breaking the rules, nothing will happen!

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Like how the bodyguards and I take care of our club, the rule and special medicine made by Ms. Ezra will protect the Uluru Stadium!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Ms.?

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Oh? What's wrong, Ms. Ezra?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Ms. Bunny, but you see ... I'm not a Ms.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Huh?
Bunny Bunny slowly tilts her head.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: You are funny, Ms. Ezra. Please stop teasing me. What else can you be except a lady? A gentleman?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ezra is indeed a he.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: ... Huh?
The bunny girl's voice starts to sound hesitant.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: A-A HE?!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Aah! Ms. Spathodea, you're awake! Here, take this water and the nutrition supplement capsule.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: No no no no, NOOOO ...
Spathodea, hands trembling, pushes away the pills and water.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: You-You're a boy? When did you ... turn into a boy?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Yes, I'm a boy. I was a boy when I was born, and I have been that way since.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: What? Wait ... Wh-What? Why did you lie to me?! Why did you say you were a ... Wait, you never said you were a girl ...

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Wait, Ms. Spathodea, please don't grab me so tightly.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Hey ya, I'm back ... Emm? What happened?

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Our little Spathodea looks completely absent-minded, arms around her knees, and Missy Ezra here is holding her forehead and looks ... overwhelmed?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: She ... Um, he! He is not a "missy"! He's a buddy!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Aah ... Buddy Ezra? So what, boy or girl, is that such a big deal?
Desert Flannel waves the papers around and puts them on the table in front of Spathodea.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Nothing is more important than this!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: "Dear Ms. Vertin, I am glad to hear from you ..."

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: No no, not that one. That's for Vertin ... from some guy called Slouch Hat.
She fishes out a page out of the pile in Spathodea's hand and throws it to Vertin.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, thank you. He's my contact in Australia. We've been writing letters these days.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: So what am I supposed to look at then? This one?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Large-scale Event Application Form ... Alice Springs Government ... Oh! This is! This is that thing!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Haha! Yeees! We just need to go to the City Hall, fill in the form, and submit it! Then we're ready to have our Uluru Games!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: What are we waiting for then? Let's hit the road!
She throws back the covers and leaps out of the bed.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: No! Ms. Spathodea! You haven't fully recovered. You need to rest!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I'm not feeling that bad ... Actually I'm feeling really good! That's right—reeeally good!
The little girl grips the arm of her doctor and gives him a rough shake.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: The City Hall is not like a no man's land. We're just going there to fill in some forms. They won't hurt me, okay? O-kay?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: No ... NO. This time is different.
The doctor tries to stay solid as a rock amidst the storm of shaking.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: This is not like what happened before, Ms. Spathodea!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: I'm your doctor, and I'm responsible for your health. I can't let you leave my sight.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Your sight ... Your sight ... Oh! Got it!
Spathodea stopped shaking but began pulling hard instead.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: You can come with me! C'mon, c'mon!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Time waits for no man. Our Summer Games are about to start!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Wa-Wait ... Whaaah!
The kids disappear at the end of the hallway, their yells and shouts lingering a little longer.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Whoa ... Ms. Spathodea is surely a good runner, even faster than the potion-drunk Ms. Sotheby ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: OK, since the doctor and the patient are both happy, I, the event assistance producer, am also hitting the road!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Wait for our good news!
Alice Springs City Government

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: What are these? And this?! Look, I know English, but I don't understand any of the things written here.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: What is "Northern Territory Event Security Law"? And what is "Type III Field Safety Certification"?

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: I think I will just go with C here for Event Types. That's what looks closest to the Uluru Games, since they're both two-word phrases ...

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Maybe, let's just go with that one.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I always go with C when I have no idea what I'm reading ...
Desert Flannel buries her head in her hands, wailing, while Spathodea keeps biting her pencil.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Mass Event Application, Fire Escape Plan ... Ms. Spathodea, does the Stadium have a fire escape?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: ... Not in Flammy's memory. Let me check Spathodea's ... Alright, I have no idea at all. The sports are all that I care about ...

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Well ... I'm just gonna write down an "unknown" here ...

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: You ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: How are ya, my grumpy little friend? Finally made up your mind to help?
Ezra opens and shuts his mouth, shaking his head roughly.
At ease as he seems, deep down he is like a cat on hot bricks.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: No ... I have no desire to help a patient who doesn't care about her own health. You are on your own.

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: City Government Service Center, District B, Window 13 at your service. Thanks for your waiting. Your form will be exami- ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Oh, great, she stopped. What happened?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: That's not a good look. I've seen that look on Ms. Judy's face. She's my maths teacher ... Whenever she puts on that face ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Yes?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: It means "none of your answers are correct!"

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: A-ha ...
Failure.
A sheet of paper stained with ink is returned, and its owners talk to each other, walking away from the service window.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Told you we can't fill "Who knows" in the form ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Who knows you can't write that!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Please check this one.

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: Yes, Ms. Desert ... I'm sorry, and you are ...

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Hellooo! I am Spathodea, the director of the event!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: This counter is wayyy too high! Should've let Desert Flannellll talk to you!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: But she'ssss feeling sick after reading the form!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Sooooo, I have to do it insteaaaad!

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: ... I will prepare a stool for you. Please stop jumping.
Another failure.
Her form failed, that is true, but at least she gets a stool to step onto.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Ugh! Yes, with this stool, I don't have to jump up again and again!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Here's the form we revised. Please check it!

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: ... Alright.

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: You've submitted the Arcanist Gathering Registration Form, the Mass Events Application Form, and the Desert Areas Gathering Application Form.

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: Your application will be in the approval process very soon.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Gosh, YESSS! I'd go crazy if I had to fill in them again!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I've never experienced such pain. We cried on each other's shoulder several times!

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: Same for me.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I'm sorry?

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: It's nothing. But please take a look here at the second half of the Sports Game Process & Events Application Form. Most of the events of your application have been confirmed not approved.

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: If you want to add them to the Uluru Games, an independent application for each event's security permissions is required.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: How can I get the permissions then?
Forms. More forms. Indigestible forms.

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: You need to fill in these forms and take live photos for the events you want to apply for.
What a miserable piece of news.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Ughhhh.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Excuse meeee, please, give me the foooorms!
Another tiny figure jumps up from under the counter.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: I'll take caaaaare of them.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Let the giiiirls ... leave and rest ...!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Ezra ...
All the miserable tears suddenly change into tears of joy. She gives him a bear hug.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Mmm?!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Gosh, that's so kind of you! You are the kindest person of all the kind people I know! Thank you, Ezra!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I can't promise I'll stay in bed for the next three days, but-but I'll take the medicines in time! No hesitation!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: No worries, Spathodea. I've also learned something today.
The little researcher helplessly smiles, his face pale.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: That is, it pains me more to see people suffer than to endure my own suffering. I prefer to give them a hand.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Please leave the paperwork to me. I can jump to reach the counter.

items.speaker: Government Staff
items.text: Stool. Take another stool over there.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Ah. Yes. Jumping for too long would cause irreversible damage to my meniscus. Thank you so much!
Behind the glass, the exhausted receptionist finally shows a smile of relief.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: The Games and Flammy woke me up when I was still a small flame a millennia ago. They made me fanatic and crazy.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: How amazing, my young friend. I'm just like the present me when I talk to you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What do you mean "the present me"?

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: An old flame that has been burning for over a thousand years.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: You are smart, and your ideas are fun. I've been paying attention to you when I was still a small flame. Looks like you have a lot of expectations for the Uluru Games.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Sometimes it feels like ... you care about the Games even more than Flammy does.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I do have hopes for it. My wish to revive the Games is stronger than Ezra's, and my expectations for it are higher than Spathodea's.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: After all, we're in a different age now, which means we can achieve much more than a sports game.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But to be honest, I'm impressed by Ms. Spathodea's energy and passion for all these. She's ... Huh? Who are those people by her side?
The little girl excitedly walks on the sand, her hands waving in the air and pointing each part of the space for their usages. Behind her, an engineering team follows.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: From here, toooo, here!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I wanna build a neat entrance here. I also need a kiosk and a fridge with drinks!

items.speaker: Repairman
items.text: Okay. Our engineer will bring you the suitable sample materials before tomorrow 5 p.m. You can make a choice then.

items.speaker: Repairman
items.text: And you will see the architectural drawing tomorrow morning.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Spathodea, who are they?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: They are engineers from Laplace!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Our buildings don't meet the government's requirements, so we have to repair them.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Ezra called them from Alice Springs, and Laplace seems very supportive. They took the fastest ride and got here in less than an hour!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Repair? Will they change the internal structure of the Stadium?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Of course not! There's no way I'd let them do that!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: The Uluru Stadium is not a creation of arcanists', but a gift from great nature and its noble spirit. All we will do inside is sweat and let our spirits burn!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait.
Squeak.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Hmm? I think I just heard something ...
Huff, huff.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: I heard it too ... It's ...

items.speaker: Bunyip
items.text: *roars*

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: The Bunyips! And those Thorny Devils! They must have snuck out from the Stadium!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Ugh, darn those tabloids! We're at the center of the storm now! These things just won't let us go, like some cockroaches attracted to an open jar of jam!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: There are scraps of paper sticking to the corner of their mouths. Is that newspaper?

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: "MAYHEM! REVIVAL SQUAD OF ULURU GAMES IN CITY HALL WITH BUNNY GIRL?! MENTAL BREAKDOWN OF RECEPTIONIST! Exclusive on Australian Nagger ..."

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Gosh, children ... What have you done out there?!
